findings_non_blocking.title: Host .env violates two of the seven trading invariants; the round relied on a process-level safety override
findings_non_blocking.evidence: Read-only inspection of the gitignored .env (mtime 2026-08-04 04:39, unmodified by this round) shows ALPHAPILOT_PAPER_TRADING_ENABLED=true and ALPHAPILOT_FUTU_ENABLE_TRADE=true. Loading Settings in a plain process reproduces paper_trading_enabled=True and futu_enable_trade=True, so an unoverridden process fails the safety preflight closed before any network request.
findings_non_blocking.why_not_a_blocker: The gate was satisfied genuinely rather than weakened: gate code is byte-identical to the code approved at 8d1e14a, the executing process reported all seven invariants false in both safety_before and safety_after, the news_poll job performs no trading operation, and the database independently shows 1 proposal / 1 SIMULATE order unchanged with zero non-SIMULATE orders. Without the override the next round simply fails closed, which is the safe outcome.
findings_non_blocking.standing_risk: Long-running processes started without the override (for example the API service) run with paper_trading_enabled and futu_enable_trade true. Order placement remains blocked by futu_enable_account_mutation=false, live_trading_enabled=false, trading_mode=research and the permanently blocked unlock_trade, so the residual exposure is bounded but real.
findings_non_blocking.structural_protection: The scheduler hardening pinned by the S6 guard (scheduler_main.py SHA efcedebe...6265f) fails closed on exactly these two keys, so scheduler activation is structurally impossible until .env is corrected. The latent misconfiguration is now visible and enforced rather than silent.
findings_non_blocking.required_remediation_owner: Set ALPHAPILOT_PAPER_TRADING_ENABLED=false and ALPHAPILOT_FUTU_ENABLE_TRADE=false in the host .env before any scheduler activation review. This reviewer did not modify .env: it is production host configuration and outside a read-only review.
findings_non_blocking.condition_on_next_round: The next evidence package must record BOTH the persisted .env effective values AND the process-effective values, and must state any divergence explicitly.

findings_non_blocking.title: Deduplication dispositions are recorded only at source aggregate level, so per-day attribution is inferred rather than proven
findings_non_blocking.evidence: stats.sources.cninfo records inserted=646, duplicate_url=1359, duplicate_content_hash=5 for the run as a whole; the per-slice records carry fetched and pagination fields but no per-slice insert or duplicate counts. The evidence file's per-slice inserted values (108/538) are derivable only from published_at day, which this reviewer independently reproduced from the database (108 and 538), but the five content-hash drops cannot be attributed to a specific day from the recorded evidence.
findings_non_blocking.quantified_effect: Database rows for 2026-08-04 CST total 1529 against an upstream day listing of 1533. The content hash is computed over (title, content, symbol, published CST day), so content-identical announcements filed under different URLs on the same day collapse to one row. This is the pre-registered dual URL/content-hash dedup semantic operating as contracted, not a coverage hole: fetch coverage is separately proven complete because fetched equals the frozen probe totals exactly on both days and no page cap was hit.
findings_non_blocking.why_not_a_blocker: Every fetched candidate has exactly one recorded disposition and the aggregate identity 646 + 1359 + 5 = 2010 closes exactly. Nothing vanished silently; only the day-level attribution of five drops is unprovable from the record.
findings_non_blocking.condition_on_next_round: Record inserted, duplicate_url and duplicate_content_hash per slice so day-level persistence attribution becomes provable rather than inferred.
findings_non_blocking.forward_looking_note: Because the hash ignores the announcement id, two genuinely distinct documents filed by the same issuer under an identical title on the same day would collapse into one row. This is a pre-existing frozen semantic and must not be changed mid-migration; it should be evaluated as a contract question before P4.2b consumes announcement bodies.

findings_non_blocking.title: The evidence JSON safety block reads as host state while the seven invariants were process-effective values
findings_non_blocking.evidence: safety_evidence in the evidence JSON lists the seven invariants as false with settings_before_and_after_equal=true, without disclosing the process-level override or the divergence from persisted .env. The specification note in commit 8e910de does disclose it, so the disclosure exists but not in the machine-readable artifact a future automated gate would consume.
findings_non_blocking.why_not_a_blocker: The disclosure exists in the frozen specification record committed alongside the evidence, and the substantive facts are true for the executing process.
findings_non_blocking.condition_on_next_round: Carry the persisted-versus-effective settings disclosure inside the evidence JSON itself.

authorization_issued.receipt_reuse_control_gap: The loader validates schema, config binding, execution mode, authorization identity, explicit UTC timestamp and gate booleans, but cannot enforce single use. The round-2 receipt therefore binds expected_checkpoint_date_shanghai_before=2026-08-04 and expected_slice_dates=[2026-08-05, 2026-08-06] so that any reuse produces slices that visibly contradict the receipt and is detectable at the next evidence review. Single use is a governance obligation enforced by review, not by code, and this reviewer records that limitation openly.
